summary: IceCure Medical filed a 6-K announcing director Yang Huang's decision, notified October 4, 2026, not to seek re-election. The company's Israeli-law equivalent of a US annual meeting proxy statement was amended to remove Huang-related agenda items, superseding a September 28, 2026 6-K. Huang will serve until the November 2, 2026 Annual and Special General Meeting, with an October 5 record date; the board recommends FOR all remaining proposals. The departure is stated as unrelated to any disagreement, so it is an orderly board transition rather than a forced event; watch the meeting outcome and any further board changes.
